fields.title: Kōgyōyō Kyōkyū Busshi Wariawase oyobi Haikyō Keiyaku

contract.subject: Kōgyō bumon ni okeru busshi kyōkyū to wariate kijun no settei

agreement.purpose: Kōgyō rōdōsha no saiteki seikatsu suijun to seisan katsudō no hoshō.
terms: Kyōkyū wariate wa katsudō rōdō jin’in no sūryō ni shitagatte teiki ni chōsei sareru koto.
Fukusō shizai ga hassei shita baai, kyōka sareta seikyū ni yori zōryō ga kyoka sareru koto.

party_a: Kōgyō rōdōsha meibo to zaimu kiroku o seishiki ni teisyutsu suru koto.
party_b: Rōdō jin’in ni tekigō shita kyōkyū busshi o teikyō suru koto.

claims.fact: Keiyaku sho wa rōdō jin’in ni oojita wariate no chōsei gimu o kitei shite iru.
